# Jazz Practice Hub

> A browser tool for organising jazz practice: a filterable repertoire of standards, a setlist builder, a technique matrix and a practice-plan generator.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/

A single-page app, free, no sign-up. Data is kept in your own browser.

## What it does

- Repertoire: jazz standards with composer, tune family, feel, difficulty and tempo; search and filter, and mark each tune Learning, Polishing or Ready.
- Setlist: build a set, with presets for intros and endings, and export it as CSV.
- Technique matrix: a grid of skills across all 12 keys to track progress.
- Practice planner: a daily practice generator with metronome-placement ideas; print or export.

## Pages

- [Jazz Practice Hub](https://jazz-practice-hub.netlify.app/): the app.
